laws.rule: Table Mountain National Park daily conservation fees, 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2027, international visitors: Cape Point R592 adult (12+), R288 child (2 to 11); Boulders R282 and R138; Newlands, Oudekraal, Silvermine and Tokai R230 and R115. No RBA rate for ZAR.
Cape Point and Boulders gates are cash-free (cards only); one payment per vehicle at Cape Point. The standard (international) rate is applied unless South African ID is shown.
